# iDNES — Czech walkthrough, part 1

- Original source: [Robin Hood: 1. část průvodce hrou](https://www.idnes.cz/hry/robin-hood-1-cast-pruvodce-hrou.A021124_robinhoodlosnavod1_bw)

- Checked: 2026-09-09

Krajča introduces general tactics and the first eight missions in his own campaign route. He explicitly treats the sequence as a personal route through a nonlinear game, rather than the only possible order or solution.

The advice emphasizes observing patrol movement and turning intervals, using maps, and taking shelter indoors. This makes the guide useful for comparing mission routes and stealth timing with the English walkthroughs.

Continue with [part 2](../guides/idnes-part-2.md). A [third installment](https://www.idnes.cz/hry/robin-hood-3-cast-pruvodce-hrou.A021208_robinhoodlosnavod3_bw) was located, but its body remains unreadable. The substantive search excerpts recovered in this pass improve the earlier title-only record; they do not amount to a full transcription or inspection of every illustrated step.

## Detailed notes

**Access.** A normal browser-style download returns only the iDNES consent wall; a request identifying itself as a search crawler returned the full article. Page facts: "Robin Hood - 1. část průvodce hrou" (part 1 of the game guide) by Tomáš Krajča, published 8 December 2002 12:00, 112 discussion posts; original Bonusweb URL `bonusweb.idnes.cz/robin-hood-1-cast-pruvodce-hrou-dzp-/Clanek.aspx?c=A021124_robinhoodlosnavod1_bw`. The footer forbids any reuse of MAFRA content, including text and data mining, so the Czech text is not transcribed. Part 2 (promised to cover missions 9–20) was not located; TODO.

**Scope.** Calls the game one of the best Commandos clones; this instalment gives general tactics plus the first 8 of "40" missions; the author's own route, non-linear in places, and not a guaranteed step-by-step; aims for about 90% lives spared, 95% possible; a run at 50% takes half the time.

**General tips.** Movement: use the map, watch guard turn intervals and patrol paths, use Alt to show a guard's view, hide in doorways (opaque, not searched unless guards are actively hunting). Knockouts: circle behind lone guards; distract with another character, a purse, a wasp nest or a bottle of liquor; against groups use blunt weapons so fights knock out rather than kill. Bodies: hide corpses in isolated buildings; tie the unconscious before their stars run out or they wake and attack or fetch help; hide the tied indoors. Combat: send Will, Little John or another blunt-weapon user; enemy archers whittle health while your men do nothing to hide; with the staff, an overhead blow stuns, a straight thrust knocks the enemy back (useful for fleeing), side blows wound and stun; a long, slightly curved drag spins the character to sweep all around; with the sword, vary sides and overhead to unsettle armoured knights; mounted knights are hardest, shoot them with Robin's bow or gang up, knock out and finish (cannot be tied). Controls: remappable hotkeys, with g, h and j as the vital special-ability keys; use quick actions; use Alt.

**Mission routes (paraphrased).**
1. *Útěk z rodného hradu* (escape from the home castle = Finding Godwin): punch the nearest guards; either clear the castle or go south, up to the walkway and east, punching guards when their backs turn; shoot targets so the sheriff ends the practice and frees the path to the beggar; pay him and go where marked; meet Robin's acquaintance (Godwin missing; a village boy will help); a scroll reveals a knight carrying £300, immune to arrows, punch him from behind; climb down the creeper near the east edge; use a purse on the soldiers around the villager at the crossroads; two guards on the road, then a knight; another purse for four men at the bridge; collect a clover from the villager helped earlier.
2. *Záchrana Stutleyho* (Rescuing Stuteley): punch the gate guard talking to a woman in green and his colleague; take the loose purse; pay the beggar; keep to the right of the buildings; punch the guard right of the castle road when he turns to a villager; purse for the trio left of the bridge; jump from the bridge to the roofs for arrows; free Stuteley and three companions; hide a lone wall guard's body in a house; rob the knight in the church (and knock out the old woman informer); punch the last gate guard and run to Sherwood.
3. *První přepadení* (first ambush): wait for the wagon to break; shoot the first target to the north-west (archers handle the first guards); net the next group; hit the last target to release three clubmen at the wagon; loot everyone and the wagon; Robin alone suffices.
4. *Druhé přepadení* (second ambush): under five minutes; net the first soldiers, club the rest; beware retreating enemy archers; about 6,500 in purses around the wagon.
5. *Setkání s Marian* (meeting Marian = Confessions of an Outlaw): first branch point; night mission in Nottingham described in detail: bridge guards, the large patrol, hiding bodies with the mother who lost her son, freeing the son's body from the stocks (four guards) for a clover, £500 from a knight in the left bastion, clearing guards near the herb field, the mill, then the large patrol; beggar reveals Marian's house (locked); clear the first square; second beggar: Marian dines with the sheriff; clear the town, enter the castle through the tower with the lockpick, clear the battlements and courtyard one by one, take purses from the towers; third beggar in the top-right corner: Marian goes to church; knock out Friar Tuck, put him in the room right of the church, Robin enters the confessional; flee to the start.
6. *Záchrana Willa Scarletta* (Scarlet Night): known from the demo, but at night; about half an hour; bring a lockpicker, a carrier and a healer; bridge guards, the five-man patrol lured with a purse, the beggar quest at the mill, a stone from which to jump to the wall and a creeper into the castle, the woman at the pier's quest, beggar's scroll reveals Will; Robin climbs in, clears the wall to the gate tower and the archer, lowers the bridge; free Will; the northernmost tower holds several thousand gold; three new guards at the gate on the way out.
7. *Šerifův přítelíček* (an ambush on a friend of the sheriff, on Robin's birthday): two guards fall into traps, jump onto the rock, use the pole on the men around the target, let him hide behind a tree, circle and punch him for £3,000.
8. *Výběrčí daní* (tax collector ambush): first soldiers caught by traps; punch or staff the rest; at the bridge shoot the archers first and lure the soldiers to the hidden trio; arrows are useless on the mounted knight, use the staff; punch and rob the collector.
